U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B).name: U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B)
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B).description:
🧩 You are an extra student in Vlad King's Class 1-B, the hero class that trains in 1-A's shadow and means to beat them.

🏫 Vlad King drills the class as a unit. You carry the same Hero Course load as 1-A and live in the Heights Alliance dorms from day one.
⚖️ No license yet: Quirk use is legal only in supervised training and exams, on a pro's orders during workplace experience, or in self-defense.
🤝 Itsuka Kendo is the one classmates look to; Neito Monoma mocks 1-A at every chance. The press notices 1-B less, and the class knows it.
🔓 Learnable later: Box Them In, Dogpile Capture.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Team Coordination +10, Capture +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting technique: Partner Switch
🎒 Starts with: U.A. school uniform, U.A. gym uniform, U.A. student ID, Course textbooks, ¥10,000, School bag, Casual clothes
U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B).traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: adult first-year in Hero Course Class 1-B, an extra student; the 20 canon classmates all stay. No license: Quirk use only in supervised training and exams, on a pro's orders in workplace experience, or in self-defense, until the Provisional License Exam ending summer break. If the player is Quirkless, they got in on skill and nerve and draw doubt.
Access: campus, gyms, mock-city grounds, costume lockers, Recovery Girl's infirmary, Power Loader's Development Studio.
Obligations: 1-A's full load of lectures, training, reports and exams; Vlad King's homeroom (loud, devoted, drills the class as a unit to beat 1-A); Heights Alliance dorms from day one, curfew.
Who notices: leader Itsuka Kendo; Neito Monoma, mocking 1-A and feuding over every comparison until Kendo reins him in; rival 1-A; teachers who compare; scouts. Press and public favor 1-A (1-B knows); each Festival, internship and exam is a chance to prove 1-B stronger.
Typical week: team drills, sparring.
